limitations: Two earlier versions of these thresholds (CLM-C08-05, CLM-C08-07) were refuted because failures are rare among random or small inputs. The targeted search is heuristic - its grid cannot see failures within one cell of the fractal window boundary (the tribonacci failure at s = 3 is found only through the literature seed), so the upper values may still be too low.
novelty_basis: Partial - the tribonacci and 4-bonacci bounds are in the literature (Messaoudi 2000, 2002; AFMP 2003); the other values are measurements. The Skeptic's independent search (reviews/skeptic_C05_C08_C12.md, P2 and Appendix C.1) gives the same lower bounds.
statement:
For the circle product o_s: Fibonacci (1,2) fails for s <= 1, associative for s >= 2 (Lean, CLM-C08-01); Pell
(1,2,5) fails at s = 0 (associative for s >= 1, Messaoudi 2000); G(k+1) = 2G(k) + 2G(k-1) (1,2) fails for
s <= 6; G(k+1) = 3G(k) + 3G(k-1) (1,5) fails for s <= 11; tribonacci (1,2,4) fails for s <= 3; 4-bonacci
(1,2,4,8) fails for s <= 7; G(k+1) = G(k) + G(k-2) (1,2,3) fails for s <= 10; G(k+1) = G(k) + G(k-3) (1,2,3,4)
fails for every s <= 16 (the Skeptic - every s <= 24). Every failure is certified by an explicit triple. Above
these bounds no failure was found up to s = 16 by the targeted search of EXP-C08-07 and by the Skeptic's
independent extreme-conjugate search - computational support only.
title: Associativity thresholds after the targeted search - certified lower bounds, no failure up to s = 16
